purpose: Identify useful cross-check and acquisition leads for foundational statutes. These links are not permission grants and secondary text must not be promoted to primary-source status.

evidence.publisher: World Intellectual Property Organization — WIPO Lex
evidence.observed_title: Law No. 82 of 2002 on the Protection of Intellectual Property Rights, Egypt
evidence.finding: WIPO Lex describes an Arabic consolidated text amended through Law 178/2020 and identifies other amendment instruments. Because the consolidation stops in 2020, it is a valuable amendment-history starting point but not proof of current 2026 status.
evidence.next_action: Review WIPO terms before any reuse; obtain Gazette texts for Law 178/2020 and listed earlier amendments, then search for amendments after September 2020.

evidence.source_class: government-hosted reference PDF / version not established
evidence.finding: Government-hosted reference copy may help identify the law's structure, but its consolidated-through date and amendment completeness are not established from the discovery result.

evidence.observed_title: قانون تنظيم الشهر العقاري رقم 114 لسنة 1946
evidence.finding: Useful bibliographic lead for Law 114/1946 and its implementing regulation. The source labels the law amended, so this is not a current consolidated text.
evidence.next_action: Locate the original Gazette and implementing regulation, map each amendment, and separately cover Law 68/1947 on notarization.

evidence.observed_title: قانون إنشاء محاكم الأسرة رقم 10 لسنة 2004
evidence.finding: Useful metadata for locating the original family-courts law and related amendments. The platform marks the law amended.
evidence.next_action: Locate the original Gazette, identify all amending instruments and related personal-status procedures, and obtain family-lawyer review.

evidence.observed_title: Law No. 174 of 2025 on the Issuance of the Criminal Procedure Law
evidence.finding: Useful to locate the 2025 enactment but predates Law 160/2026, which official source discovery indicates changed the commencement date. This record must not be used alone to describe current operative status.
evidence.next_action: Review ILO terms, acquire authorized Gazette texts for both Laws 174/2025 and 160/2026, and obtain criminal-procedure counsel sign-off.

guardrails: A secondary database page is a discovery/cross-check source, not the authoritative publication record.
A label such as 'amended' does not identify every amendment or prove the current consolidated wording.
A text consolidated only through 2020 must be treated as potentially stale for 2026.
Do not bulk download, scrape, or reuse any source without reviewing access terms and permission for the intended use.
Do not promote any entry to acquired, verified, or in-force based only on these leads.
